title: Update auth.py
description: Modify the authentication module to fix the session expiry handling and add rate limiting to the login endpoint. The current implementation does not invalidate expired sessions and has no throttling.
acceptance_criteria: Expired sessions are invalidated on access. Login endpoint is rate-limited to 5 attempts per minute per IP. Existing tests continue to pass.

metadata.intent: Harden the authentication module against session fixation and brute-force attacks.
